1.explanation:
• button.scss: this is where the base .bx--btn, size modifier (.bx--btn--sm) and ghost modifier (.bx--btn--ghost) CSS rules live — you’ll find the height, padding, and line-height settings for the small ghost variant here.  
• Button.js: shows how the size and variant props map to CSS class names (e.g. adding bx--btn--sm and bx--btn--ghost) — necessary to confirm that the component is actually rendering the correct modifiers.  
• button.stories.js: reproduces the small ghost button in Storybook so you can validate the markup, inspect the computed styles, and verify whether the story’s knobs or args are setting the right props.  
• migrate-to-7.x.md: contains notes on the recent sizing changes and migration rationale — helps you understand what was intended when adjusting small button sizes, and why the 32px target was chosen in conversation #3283.
1.bug_scenario: In the Storybook demo and in the rendered screenshot, the small “ghost” button (i.e. a button carrying both the bx--btn--sm and bx--btn--ghost modifiers) is measuring 36px tall in the browser’s layout inspector, but per the design conversation it should be 32px tall. The extra 4px is coming from either a padding or line-height discrepancy in the SCSS for the small/ghost modifier combination.
